[GitHub Copilot licenses > Licenses for Copilot > Enterprise licensing models]

The Copilot access plan is rolling out to eligible enterprises. It provides Copilot through GitHub Enterprise Cloud with no Copilot seat charge, or as Copilot Standalone for $10 USD per user per month without a GitHub Enterprise Cloud license. It has no included usage allowance. Existing plans remain supported, and transitioning is voluntary.

[GitHub Copilot licenses > Free use of Copilot > Copilot Free]

- Provides limited access to Copilot features at no cost.
- Includes a monthly allowance of completions and limited chat and agent usage.
- Intended for **individual use only** (not suitable for organizations or enterprises).
- For usage beyond the free plan limits, upgrade to Copilot Pro.
